annotations.title: Capture the web build at a phone's size

description: Saves a screenshot of a page of the app's web build (a dev server like http://localhost:8081, or the web's testing address) at exactly a store's size, with Chrome or Edge in the background: an iPhone 6.9-inch (1320×2868) by default, an iPad, or a Google Play phone. It's the way to make iPhone screenshots on Windows or Linux, where there's no iOS Simulator, for an app whose web build is the same app (Expo, Flutter, React Native for web). Apple wants screenshots of the app itself in use: show the person the result and use it only when the web build looks like the iPhone app (no browser-only parts, the same screens). It doesn't navigate or tap: open each screen by its address (an Expo Router path). Then ploa_screenshot_check and ploa_screenshot_upload.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

folder.description: Where to save it (absolute path). Default: screenshots/ in the project.

type.description: The store's display type: APP_IPHONE_67 (default), APP_IPHONE_65, APP_IPAD_PRO_3GEN_129, or Google Play's phoneScreenshots, sevenInchScreenshots, tenInchScreenshots.

waitMs.description: How long the page may load before the shot, in ms (default 4000, up to 20000).

name: ploa_screenshot_web
title: Capture the web build at a phone's size
